2014_spells.lightning-bolt.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.
2014_spells.lightning-bolt.effectSummary: Deal 8d6 lightning damage to a target within Self
